description: Matches and what happened in them. With matchId: view "summary" (default) gives the state, each robot's revision, placement and combat summary, and the replay; "events" every event and your robots' debug.log lines and drone reports with a few sampled states; "ticks" robot states turn by turn, with the health each lost by cause, and your robots' requests, what the referee accepted and what they sensed (fromTick, toTick, every; pages by nextFromTick); "decisions" your strategist robots' recorded decisions. Without matchId, a list newest first: scope "mine" (default; the matches you queued, by state), "played" (every match one of your robots played, with its record by game and revision on the first page), "public" (recent public matches), "replays" (public replays) or "latest" (each of your robots' latest replay). Replays are kept 30 days.

every.description: view ticks: sample every nth tick (default 1); events and log lines are never skipped

limit.description: Rows a page holds at most (default 20); fewer when rows would pass the size limit

opponent.description: Only matches this robot also played

rated.description: false for practice and other unrated matches

revision.description: scope played: only this revision ordinal

statsFor.description: view summary: a robot whose full statistics to add

name: matches
